name: Muchi
tagline: A little company for your day.
shortDescription: A cozy desktop pet to share snacks, little games, and quiet moments with. Coming to Windows as a free-to-play game.
paragraphs: Meet Muchi, a desktop companion who wanders, plays, and rests alongside your day. A short break between emails or everyday tasks can become a little moment together.
No rush, no pressure. Share some affection, enjoy a quick game, or let him rest while you do your own thing.
Plant seeds, water them, and watch flowers grow beside your everyday tasks. A little garden brings a splash of color to the space between appointments.

highlights.title: Little moments of care.
highlights.text: Show him affection, offer a snack or some water, and let him settle into a nap while you carry on with your day.

highlights.title: Make time for a little play.
highlights.text: Take a break with a card game, tic-tac-toe, or a memory match against Muchi. Or start some bubble play and watch him chase the floating bubbles.

highlights.title: Grow a little color.
highlights.text: Plant seeds, water them, and watch flowers grow beside your everyday tasks. A little garden brings a splash of color to the space between appointments.
